card.fires_on: The middle piece of split-up words built on cortisol or corticosteroid, such as Cort|ic|osteroids, hyperc|ort|isolism and hypoc|ort|isolism. It also fires on the middle of beclomethasone.

modes.example: Overdosage may result in severe hypoc<<ort>>isolism.
